cards.ex: It took years, but he's finally clean and sober and rebuilding his life.
cards.exUz: Uzoq yillar ketdi, ammo u nihoyat sog'lom hayotga qaytdi va o'z hayotini qayta qurmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Giyohvandlik yoki ichkilikdan butunlay voz kechib, sog'lom turmush tarzini boshlash.

cards.ex: I'm a sucker for a good mystery novel; I can't resist them.
cards.exUz: Men yaxshi sirli romanlarga zaifman; ularga qarshi tura olmayman.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir kuchli zaiflik, qoyillatib tura olmaydigan narsa.

cards.ex: He's been on the wagon for six months now, and he feels great.
cards.exUz: U olti oydan beri ichmayapti va o'zini ajoyib his qilyapti.
cards.uzDef: Alkogol ichishni to'xtatish, spirtli ichimliklardan voz kechish.

cards.ex: Smoking is a bad habit that's hard to break.
cards.exUz: Chekish - tashlash qiyin bo'lgan yomon odat.
cards.uzDef: Salbiy oqibatlarga olib keladigan odat, zararli xulq-atvor.

cards.ex: Some video games can be habit-forming, especially for young people.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi video o'yinlar odatlantiruvchi bo'lishi mumkin, ayniqsa yoshlar uchun.
cards.uzDef: Odatga aylanish ehtimoli yuqori bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: His gambling addiction sent him into a downward spiral of debt and despair.
cards.exUz: Uning qimorga qaramligi uni qarzdorlik va umidsizlikning pastga qarab ketishiga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatning tobora yomonlashuvi, chuqurlashuvi.

cards.ex: Chocolate is my only vice; I try to eat healthy otherwise.
cards.exUz: Shokolad mening yagona yomon odatim; aks holda sog'lom ovqatlanishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Odamning yashirincha bajaradigan yomon odati.

cards.ex: It's easy to fall prey to online scams if you're not careful.
cards.exUz: Agar ehtiyot bo'lmasangiz, onlayn firibgarliklarga qurbon bo'lish oson.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir salbiy ta'siriga tushib qolmoq.

cards.ex: She has obsessive-compulsive tendencies when it comes to cleaning.
cards.exUz: Uning tozalashga kelganda majburiy holatga moyilligi bor.
cards.uzDef: Takrorlanuvchi fikrlar va harakatlar bilan bog'liq holat.

cards.ex: I hope this new diet trend is just a passing fad.
cards.exUz: Umid qilamanki, bu yangi dieta tendentsiyasi shunchaki vaqtinchalik moda.
cards.uzDef: Tez orada unutiladigan qisqa muddatli ommabop tendentsiya.

cards.ex: I'm caught in a loop of checking my phone every five minutes.
cards.exUz: Men har besh daqiqada telefonimni tekshirish aylanishiga tushib qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Takrorlanuvchi fikrlar yoki harakatlarda doimiy ravishda ishtirok etish.

cards.ex: I had a strong urge to buy that new gadget, even though I didn't need it.
cards.exUz: Menda yangi gadjetni sotib olishga kuchli istak bor edi, garchi menga kerak bo'lmasa ham.
cards.uzDef: Qarshilik qilish qiyin bo'lgan kuchli xohish.

cards.ex: He has a one-track mind when it comes to football; it's all he ever talks about.
cards.exUz: U futbolga kelganda faqat bir maqsadga ega; u faqat shu haqida gapiradi.
cards.uzDef: Faqat bitta narsa haqida o'ylash, boshqa narsalarga e'tibor bermaslik.

cards.ex: Don't go overboard with the decorations; keep it simple.
cards.exUz: Dekoratsiyalar bilan chegaradan chiqmang; uni oddiy saqlang.
cards.uzDef: Haddan tashqari ko'p qilish, me'yorni buzish.

cards.ex: It's just a matter of time before he relapses; he hasn't truly dealt with his issues.
cards.exUz: Uning qayta kasal bo'lishi faqat vaqt masalasi; u o'z muammolari bilan haqiqatan ham kurashmagan.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir sodir bo'lishi muqarrar, faqat vaqt kerak.

cards.ex: I'm trying to give up sugar for my health.
cards.exUz: Men sog'lig'im uchun shakardan voz kechishga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Odatni tashlash, nimadandir butunlay voz kechish.

cards.ex: She's afraid to leave her comfort zone and try new things.
cards.exUz: U o'zining qulay zonasidan chiqib, yangi narsalarni sinab ko'rishdan qo'rqadi.
cards.uzDef: O'zini xavfsiz va qulay his qiladigan muhit.

cards.ex: He lost control and started shouting at everyone.
cards.exUz: U nazoratni yo'qotdi va hamma ustidan baqira boshladi.
cards.uzDef: O'z xatti-harakatlarini boshqara olmaslik.

cards.ex: I went on a shopping spree; I guess I was indulging in some retail therapy.
cards.exUz: Men xarid qilish uchun bordim; menimcha, men xarid terapiyasi bilan shug'ullanayotgan edim.
cards.uzDef: Xarid qilish orqali o'zini yaxshi his qilishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The more stressed I get, the more I eat; it's a vicious cycle.
cards.exUz: Qanchalik ko'p stressga tushsam, shunchalik ko'p ovqat yeyman; bu aylanma sikl.
cards.uzDef: O'zini kuchaytiradigan salbiy hodisalar ketma-ketligi.

cards.ex: His obsessive behavior made it difficult for him to maintain relationships.
cards.exUz: Uning takroriy xatti-harakatlari unga munosabatlarni saqlab qolishni qiyinlashtirdi.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy takrorlanadigan fikrlar yoki harakatlar bilan bog'liq xatti-harakatlar.

cards.ex: I enjoy sweets, but moderation is key to a healthy diet.
cards.exUz: Men shirinliklardan zavqlanaman, lekin sog'lom ovqatlanish uchun me'yor muhim.
cards.uzDef: Hech narsani haddan tashqari ko'p qilmaslik kerakligi haqida maslahat.

cards.ex: He uses alcohol as a crutch to deal with his anxiety.
cards.exUz: U tashvish bilan kurashish uchun alkogolni tayanch sifatida ishlatadi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda yordam beradigan, lekin mustaqillikka to'sqinlik qiladigan narsa.

cards.ex: You need to get a grip and calm down; panicking won't help.
cards.exUz: O'zingizni tutishingiz va tinchlanishingiz kerak; vahima yordam bermaydi.
cards.uzDef: O'z his-tuyg'ularini nazorat qilish, vahima qilmaslik.

cards.ex: She has a weakness for designer handbags; she can't resist buying them.
cards.exUz: Uning dizaynerlik sumkalarga zaifligi bor; ularni sotib olishga qarshi tura olmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir juda qattiq xohish, qarshi tura olmaslik.

cards.ex: Relapse prevention is an important part of recovery.
cards.exUz: Qaytalanishning oldini olish tiklanishning muhim qismidir.
cards.uzDef: Qaramlikdan keyin qayta kasal bo'lishning oldini olish usullari.

cards.ex: He had a burning desire to become a successful musician.
cards.exUz: U muvaffaqiyatli musiqachi bo'lish uchun yonuvchi istakka ega edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kuchli, qondirishni xohlaydigan istak.

cards.ex: His self-destructive behavior was a cry for help.
cards.exUz: Uning o'zini buzuvchi xatti-harakatlari yordam so'rashi edi.
cards.uzDef: O'ziga zarar yetkazadigan xatti-harakatlar.

cards.ex: This diet is just a quick fix; it won't help you lose weight in the long run.
cards.exUz: Bu dieta shunchaki tez yechim; u uzoq muddatda vazn yo'qotishingizga yordam bermaydi.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni vaqtincha hal qiladigan, lekin asosiy sababni bartaraf etmaydigan yechim.

cards.ex: He's easily swayed by advertising; he buys everything he sees on TV.
cards.exUz: U reklamadan osongina ta'sirlanadi; u televizorda ko'rgan hamma narsani sotib oladi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarning fikriga osongina ta'sir qilish mumkin bo'lgan.
